task.name: Strike_EMT_shade
task.when: During Strike after every shelter and item beneath the shade is removed

resources.resource: Build Lead and the crew count printed in 📦 Build_Book
Work gloves, eye protection, and closed-toe shoes

step.action: Confirm that every shelter, person, and belonging beneath the shade has been removed.
Confirm that the Power Lead released every attached light and cable.
Confirm the current lowering sequence, crew positions, and packing groups in 📦 Build_Book.
Close the work area to people not on the strike crew.
Remove and fold the side coverings while all structural anchors remain installed.
step.ifThen: IF wind prevents control of a covering, THEN secure it and stop.

step.action: Remove and fold the roof covering in the printed bay sequence while the frame remains anchored.
Remove the ground-covering fasteners and put them in the hardware bin.
Clean, dry, fold, and pack each ground covering.
Release braces, straps, and anchors only in the printed lowering sequence.
Lower each frame section only on the Build Lead's command.
Dismantle each lowered frame section in the printed reverse sequence.
Remove every remaining lag screw, chain, anchor, and ground fastener.
Bundle horizontal and vertical EMT groups with ratchet straps.
Put every fitting, fastener, bungee, chain, and anchor in its assigned hardware bin.

passWhen.criterion: Every covering, tube, fitting, fastener, bungee, strap, chain, and anchor is accounted for and packed.
No anchor or ground fastener remains in the playa.
The former shade footprint is clear and MOOP-free.

reasoning.entry: The outdated source removes anchors before coverings; the canonical order keeps the frame anchored until sail-producing coverings are removed.
